sandbachFocus: Sandbach United delivered a dominant performance against Widnes Town, running out 6-0 winners in comprehensive fashion. Goals from Kyle Foley (2), Kieran O'Connell, Stan Tatters, Nathan Barry, and Robbie Hatton secured the emphatic victory, with Widnes reduced to 10 men following a red card in the 71st minute. The Bach created countless chances throughout and played what their social media described as 'delightful football,' maintaining their impressive form with another commanding three points.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth held top spot despite a scare, coming from behind to edge New Mills 3-2 in an entertaining encounter where Josh Lowe's early red card (mistaken identity incident) didn't stop the Millers from leading before Bridgnorth's late comeback. Eccleshall picked up a narrow 1-0 away win at Cheadle Heath Nomads courtesy of Dylan Bath's early goal, maintaining their push toward the summit. Wolverhampton Casuals overcame Alsager Town 2-0 at home with goals from Liam Kirton and Richard David, while Barnton delivered a dominant 4-0 home demolition of Wednesfield Community to reach five games unbeaten. Bilston Town earned a 3-1 victory over Stafford Town in a one-sided affair where poor defending cost the visitors. Foley Meir secured three points with a 2-1 home win against Brereton Social, while Dawley Town impressively beat Shawbury United 2-0 away with Ross Jones scoring twice. Crewe edged Telford Town 2-1 in a comeback win, and Market Drayton Town held on for a 2-1 victory at Allscott Heath despite playing with numerical disadvantage for a spell. New Mills' defeat dropped them to 6th, while Widnes Town remain bottom with just one point from five games.
